Studio configures the shoot; the Director runs it; Producer monitors the production and holds the Gallery. Every shot of a film rolls on the camera you pick here — you can change it any time.

Keys load from ~/.diony/keys.env
A key is required

Every shot rolls on a cloud camera you pay for directly, so the Studio needs at least one key before the Director can shoot. Diony never asks for a key in the app: put the lines you have in ~/.diony/keys.env and reopen this page. Everything else — ffmpeg included — comes with Diony and is set up when the app opens.

ffmpeg ready — ships with Diony

On a Mac — open Terminal, paste these three lines, and put your keys in the file that opens. First open: double-click Open Diony AI.command (or Diony.app); macOS asks for your password once to lay the .diony.local names.

mkdir -p ~/.diony && chmod 700 ~/.diony
nano ~/.diony/keys.env
chmod 600 ~/.diony/keys.env

On Windows — open PowerShell, paste these two lines, and put your keys in the Notepad file that opens, then save. First open: double-click Open Diony AI.bat; Windows asks once (User Account Control) to lay the .diony.local names.

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $env:USERPROFILE\.diony | Out-Null
notepad $env:USERPROFILE\.diony\keys.env

Grok Imagine

One key: an xAI API key from console.x.ai. Metered per second of video, and the same key powers the screenwriter and the narrator voice, so the whole path is xAI.

XAI_API_KEY=xai-...

Google Flow

Two keys. A useapi.net token runs the camera: useapi.net is a relay that gives API access to Google Flow. You link a Google account that has a Google AI plan (Plus, Pro, or Ultra); Flow spends that plan's monthly credits per generation while useapi.net bills a flat subscription. See the Google Flow API docs.

A Gemini API key from Google AI Studio writes the script (Gemini 2.5 Pro) and narrates the film (Gemini speech), so the whole path is Google. It is separate from the useapi.net token and bills on its own. Without it, an xAI key writes and narrates for this camera.

USEAPI_TOKEN=user:...
# the Google account linked on useapi.net
DIONY_FLOW_EMAIL=you@gmail.com
# plus | pro | ultra-99 | ultra-199
DIONY_FLOW_PLAN=pro
# the Google brain and narrator
GEMINI_API_KEY=AIza...
